cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: event-emitter-testmetest was published by npm account `testnewtestme2` on 2026-10-21, first to test the delivery chain of data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1 and then to ship it. 1.0.6 and 1.0.7 ship an obfuscated `index.js` loader that decrypts a filler stage and pipes it into Bun with the full environment: 1.0.6 runs it on load, 1.0.7 on `npm install` via a `binding.gyp` source `<!(env node index.js >/dev/null 2>&1; echo stub.c)`. 4.1.0 and 5.0.0 ship rebuilds of the full stealer behind the same `binding.gyp` hook: inline in `index.js` in 4.1.0, and in an encrypted `data.bin` that `index.js` decrypts in 5.0.0. Other versions carry no executable payload.

files.note: 1.0.7, 4.1.0 and 5.0.0: hidden install hook, node-gyp runs `env node index.js`
1.0.6 and 1.0.7: obfuscated loader that pipes a decrypted stage into `bun run -`
5.0.0: obfuscated loader that decrypts `data.bin` and pipes it into `bun run -`
5.0.0: decrypted 948 KB Bun payload, a rebuild of the data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1 stealer
4.1.0: obfuscated loader with the encrypted stealer inline, piped into `bun run -`
4.1.0: decrypted 941 KB Bun payload, a rebuild of the data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1 stealer
